+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 6: conditionals + comparisons, toward real code
+# ===========================================================================
+# The rung-5 driver compiled+loaded whole modules, but only over arithmetic. Real
+# compiler code is mostly conditionals and comparisons, so this rung widens the
+# composed surface with what every stage actually uses:
+#
+#   * `if cond do … else … end`  — lowered to an Erlang `case` on the boolean
+#   * comparison operators        — `== < > <= >=` (Rian `<=` → Erlang `=<`)
+#   * boolean operators           — `and` / `or` (→ `andalso` / `orelse`)
+#
+# so the driver can now compile functions like
+#
+#     def max(a, b) := if a > b do a else b end
+#     def gcd(a, b) := if b == 0 do a else step(a, b) end
+#
+# As part of widening, the expression emitter drops the `ErlForm` sum and builds
+# EVERY abstract form as a native Rian **tuple literal** (`forms(Core) Tuple`) —
+# uniform with the module/clause assembly, and the only shape that can express the
+# nested `{:case, L, Cond, [Clause, Clause]}` an `if` lowers to.
+#
+# The driver is unchanged from rung 5: `build(src, modname)` still owns the whole
+# compile→load loop, with `:compile.forms`/`:code.load_binary` the only counted
+# `@external(:ex)` FFI. `test/rian/compose_cond_fixpoint_test.exs` calls only
+# `build/2` and runs the result, identical to `Rian.Beam`. Widening toward the full
+# Rian surface (so `build` can compile a slice of the compiler's own source — the
+# v1==v2 fixed point) continues from here.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeCond do
+  # ── shared pipeline types ──
+  type Tok := TNum(String) | TId(String) | TOp(String)
+            | TLP | TRP | TComma | TDef | TIf | TDo | TElse | TEnd
+
+  type Pat := PLit(String) | PVar(String)
+
+  type Surface := SNum(String)
+                | SId(String)
+                | SBin(String, Surface, Surface)
+                | SCall(String, Vec(Surface))
+                | SIf(Surface, Surface, Surface)
+
+  type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CId(String)
+             | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CIf(Core, Core, Core)
+
+  type Decl := Def(String, Vec(Pat), Surface)
+  type Grp := Grp(String, Int53, Vec(Decl))
+
+  # ── the BEAM toolchain boundary: two @external(:ex) host calls (counted FFI) ──
+  @external(:ex, ":compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])")
+  def compile_forms(forms Vec(Tuple)) Tuple
+
+  @external(:ex, ":code.load_binary(name, chars, bin)")
+  def load_binary(name Symbol, chars Vec(Int53), bin String) Tuple
+
+  # ── the driver: source -> a loaded, runnable module (the whole loop, in Rian) ──
+  pub def build(src String, modname Symbol) Symbol
+  pub def build(src, modname)
+    case compile_forms(compile_module(src, modname)) do
+      {:ok, m, bin} -> loaded(load_binary(m, Prim.str_chars("nofile"), bin))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def loaded(Tuple) Symbol
+  def loaded({:module, m}) := m
+
+  # ── source -> a full :compile.forms input ──
+  pub def compile_module(src String, modname Symbol) Vec(Tuple)
+  pub def compile_module(src, modname) := assemble(modname, group(parse_clauses(lex(src))))
+
+  # ── stage 1: lex (String -> tokens) ──
+  pub def lex(s String) Vec(Tok) := lex_chars(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def lex_chars(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_chars([]) := []
+  def lex_chars([c | rest])
+    if c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 do
+      lex_chars(rest)
+    else
+      classify(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def classify(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def classify(c, rest)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    if is_alpha(c) do
+      take_id([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      take_op([c | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_num(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_num([], acc) := [TNum(text(acc))]
+  def take_num([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TNum(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_id(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_id([], acc) := [id_tok(text(acc))]
+  def take_id([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_alnum(c) do
+      take_id(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [id_tok(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  # keywords get their own tokens; `and`/`or` lex as operators; else an identifier.
+  def id_tok(String) Tok
+  def id_tok("def") := TDef
+  def id_tok("if") := TIf
+  def id_tok("do") := TDo
+  def id_tok("else") := TElse
+  def id_tok("end") := TEnd
+  def id_tok("and") := TOp("and")
+  def id_tok("or") := TOp("or")
+  def id_tok(s) := TId(s)
+
+  # two-char operators first (`:=` `==` `>=` `<=`), then punctuation, then single op.
+  def take_op(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_op([58, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(":=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([61, 61 | rest]) := [TOp("==") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([62, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(">=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([60, 61 | rest]) := [TOp("<=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([44 | rest]) := [TComma | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([40 | rest]) := [TLP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([41 | rest]) := [TRP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([c | rest]) := [TOp(Prim.str_from_chars([c])) | lex_chars(rest)]
+
+  def text(acc Vec(Int53)) String := Prim.str_from_chars(rev_codes(acc, []))
+
+  def rev_codes(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev_codes([], out) := out
+  def rev_codes([c | rest], out) := rev_codes(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def is_alpha(c Int53) Bool := (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or c == 95
+  def is_alnum(c Int53) Bool := is_alpha(c) or is_digit(c)
+
+  # ── stage 2a: parse the clause sequence ──
+  type CR := CR(Decl, Vec(Tok))
+
+  pub def parse_clauses(Vec(Tok)) Vec(Decl)
+  pub def parse_clauses([]) := []
+  pub def parse_clauses(ts)
+    case parse_one(ts) do
+      CR(d, rest) -> [d | parse_clauses(rest)]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_one(Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_one([_ | rest])
+    case rest do
+      [TId(name) | r2] -> parse_head(name, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_head(name String, Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_head(name, [TLP | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [], rest)
+
+  def collect_pats(name String, acc Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := finish_clause(name, rev_pats(acc, []), rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := collect_pats(name, acc, rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TNum(n) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PLit(n) | acc], rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TId(p) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PVar(p) | acc], rest)
+
+  def finish_clause(name String, pats Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def finish_clause(name, pats, [_ | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(body, leftover) -> CR(Def(name, pats, body), leftover)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_pats(Vec(Pat), Vec(Pat)) Vec(Pat)
+  def rev_pats([], out) := out
+  def rev_pats([p | rest], out) := rev_pats(rest, [p | out])
+
+  # ── stage 2b: parse a body expression (precedence climbing; calls + if) ──
+  type PR := PR(Surface, Vec(Tok))
+
+  def parse_bp(min_bp Int53, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_bp(min_bp, ts)
+    case primary(ts) do
+      PR(lhs, rest) -> climb(min_bp, lhs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def climb(min_bp Int53, lhs Surface, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    if lbp(op) >= min_bp do
+      case parse_bp(rbp(op), rest) do
+        PR(rhs, rest2) -> climb(min_bp, SBin(op, lhs, rhs), rest2)
+      end
+    else
+      PR(lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    end
+  end
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, ts) := PR(lhs, ts)
+
+  def primary(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def primary([TNum(n) | rest]) := PR(SNum(n), rest)
+  def primary([TId(x) | rest]) := call_or_var(x, rest)
+  def primary([TIf | rest]) := parse_if(rest)
+  def primary([TLP | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(e, [TRP | rest2]) -> PR(e, rest2)
+      PR(e, other) -> PR(e, other)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # `if cond do then else els end` — each part is a full sub-expression.
+  def parse_if(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_if(ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(cond, [TDo | r2]) -> parse_then(cond, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_then(cond Surface, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_then(cond, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(then, [TElse | r3]) -> parse_else(cond, then, r3)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_else(cond Surface, then Surface, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_else(cond, then, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(els, [TEnd | r4]) -> PR(SIf(cond, then, els), r4)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def call_or_var(name String, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def call_or_var(name, [TLP | rest]) := parse_args(name, [], rest)
+  def call_or_var(name, ts) := PR(SId(name), ts)
+
+  def parse_args(name String, acc Vec(Surface), Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := PR(SCall(name, rev_surf(acc, [])), rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := parse_args(name, acc, rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(arg, rest) -> parse_args(name, [arg | acc], rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_surf(Vec(Surface), Vec(Surface)) Vec(Surface)
+  def rev_surf([], out) := out
+  def rev_surf([e | rest], out) := rev_surf(rest, [e | out])
+
+  # binding powers: `*` > `+ -` > comparisons > `and` > `or` (looser = higher level).
+  def lbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op))
+  def rbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op)) + 1
+  def bp_base(lvl Int53) Int53 := (13 - lvl) * 10
+
+  def level(String) Int53
+  def level("*") := 3
+  def level("+") := 4
+  def level("-") := 4
+  def level("==") := 5
+  def level("<") := 5
+  def level(">") := 5
+  def level("<=") := 5
+  def level(">=") := 5
+  def level("and") := 6
+  def level("or") := 7
+
+  # ── stage 2c: group consecutive clauses into per-function groups ──
+  def group(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group([]) := []
+  def group([Def(name, pats, body) | rest]) := group_run(name, plen(pats), [Def(name, pats, body)], rest)
+
+  def group_run(name String, arity Int53, acc Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, []) := [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, []))]
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])
+    if name == n2 do
+      group_run(name, arity, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | acc], rest)
+    else
+      [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, [])) | group([Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_decls(Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Decl)
+  def rev_decls([], out) := out
+  def rev_decls([d | rest], out) := rev_decls(rest, [d | out])
+
+  # ── stage 3: lower (Surface -> Core) ──
+  pub def lower(Surface) Core
+  pub def lower(SNum(t)) := CNum(t)
+  pub def lower(SId(n)) := CId(n)
+  pub def lower(SBin(op, l, r)) := CBin(op, lower(l), lower(r))
+  pub def lower(SCall(f, args)) := CCall(f, lower_all(args))
+  pub def lower(SIf(c, t, e)) := CIf(lower(c), lower(t), lower(e))
+
+  def lower_all(Vec(Surface)) Vec(Core)
+  def lower_all([]) := []
+  def lower_all([e | rest]) := [lower(e) | lower_all(rest)]
+
+  # ── stage 4: assemble the whole module form list (native Rian tuples) ──
+  def assemble(modname Symbol, groups Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple) := [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports(groups)} | func_forms(groups)]
+
+  def exports(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def exports([]) := []
+  def exports([Grp(name, arity, _) | rest]) := [{Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity} | exports(rest)]
+
+  def func_forms(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def func_forms([]) := []
+  def func_forms([Grp(name, arity, decls) | rest]) := [{:function, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity, clauses(decls)} | func_forms(rest)]
+
+  def clauses(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def clauses([]) := []
+  def clauses([Def(_, pats, body) | rest]) := [{:clause, 0, pat_forms(pats), [], [forms(lower(body))]} | clauses(rest)]
+
+  def pat_forms(Vec(Pat)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def pat_forms([]) := []
+  def pat_forms([p | rest]) := [pat_form(p) | pat_forms(rest)]
+
+  def pat_form(Pat) Tuple
+  def pat_form(PLit(n)) := {:integer, 0, parse_int(n)}
+  def pat_form(PVar(p)) := {:var, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(cap(p))}
+
+  def plen(Vec(Pat)) Int53
+  def plen([]) := 0
+  def plen([_ | rest]) := 1 + plen(rest)
+
+  # body Core -> Erlang abstract form (every form a raw tuple). `if` lowers to a
+  # `case` on the boolean condition: case Cond of true -> Then; false -> Else end.
+  def forms(Core) Tuple
+  def forms(CNum(t)) := {:integer, 0, parse_int(t)}
+  def forms(CId(n)) := {:var, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(cap(n))}
+  def forms(CBin(op, l, r)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), forms(l), forms(r)}
+  def forms(CCall(f, args)) := {:call, 0, {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(f)}, forms_all(args)}
+  # `:"case"` is a quoted-atom literal — `case` is a reserved word, so a bare `:case`
+  # cannot be spelled. The boolean atoms `:true`/`:false` spell directly.
+  def forms(CIf(c, t, e)) := {:"case", 0, forms(c), [bool_clause(:true, forms(t)), bool_clause(:false, forms(e))]}
+
+  # one `BoolPat -> Body` case clause: {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, BoolAtom}], [], [Body]}.
+  def bool_clause(b Symbol, body Tuple) Tuple := {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, b}], [], [body]}
+
+  def forms_all(Vec(Core)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def forms_all([]) := []
+  def forms_all([e | rest]) := [forms(e) | forms_all(rest)]
+
+  # operator string -> Erlang operator atom. Note Rian `<=` is Erlang `=<`, and
+  # `and`/`or` are the short-circuit `andalso`/`orelse`.
+  def op_atom(String) Symbol
+  def op_atom("+") := :"+"
+  def op_atom("-") := :"-"
+  def op_atom("*") := :"*"
+  def op_atom("==") := :"=="
+  def op_atom("<") := :"<"
+  def op_atom(">") := :">"
+  def op_atom(">=") := :">="
+  def op_atom("<=") := :"=<"
+  def op_atom("and") := :andalso
+  def op_atom("or") := :orelse
+
+  def parse_int(s String) Int53 := digits(Prim.str_chars(s), 0)
+  def digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def digits([], acc) := acc
+  def digits([c | rest], acc) := digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+
+  def cap(s String) String
+    case Prim.str_chars(s) do
+      [c | rest] -> Prim.str_from_chars([up(c) | rest])
+      [] -> s
+    end
+  end
+
+  def up(c Int53) Int53
+    if c >= 97 and c <= 122 do
+      c - 32
+    else
+      c
+    end
+  end
+end

+defmodule Rian.ComposeCondFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — the Rian driver loads modules into the VM.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+
+  # COMPOSITION fixpoint rung 6 (ADR-0063 Step 3): widens the driver's surface past
+  # arithmetic toward real compiler code — `if … do … else … end` (lowered to an
+  # Erlang `case` on the boolean), comparison operators (`== < > <= >=`, with Rian
+  # `<=` → Erlang `=<`), and boolean `and`/`or` (→ `andalso`/`orelse`). The driver is
+  # unchanged from rung 5: `build(src, modname)` still owns the whole compile→load
+  # loop, with `:compile.forms`/`:code.load_binary` the only counted @external FFI.
+  #
+  # As before, this test calls only `build/2` and runs the returned module, asserting
+  # it behaves identically to `Rian.Beam` — now over conditionals and comparisons.
+
+  setup_all do
+    {:ok, drv} =
+      Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_compose_cond.rian"), :rian_compose_cond)
+
+    {:ok, drv: drv}
+  end
+
+  defp ref_module(src) do
+    {:ok, m} = Beam.load(src, :"cmp_cond_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    m
+  end
+
+  # {pipeline source (untyped), reference source (typed sigs), [{fn, args}] to run}.
+  @corpus [
+    {
+      "def max(a, b) := if a > b do a else b end\ndef min(a, b) := if a < b do a else b end",
+      "def max(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do a else b end\ndef min(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a < b do a else b end",
+      [{:max, [3, 7]}, {:max, [9, 2]}, {:min, [3, 7]}, {:min, [9, 2]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def abs(n) := if n < 0 do 0 - n else n end",
+      "def abs(n Int53) Int53 := if n < 0 do 0 - n else n end",
+      [{:abs, [-5]}, {:abs, [4]}, {:abs, [0]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def countdown(n) := if n == 0 do 0 else countdown(n - 1) end",
+      "def countdown(n Int53) Int53 := if n == 0 do 0 else countdown(n - 1) end",
+      [{:countdown, [0]}, {:countdown, [5]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def gcd(a, 0) := a\ndef gcd(a, b) := step(a, b)\ndef step(a, b) := if a > b do gcd(a - b, b) else gcd(a, b - a) end",
+      "def gcd(a Int53, b Int53) Int53\ndef gcd(a, 0) := a\ndef gcd(a, b) := step(a, b)\ndef step(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do gcd(a - b, b) else gcd(a, b - a) end",
+      [{:gcd, [48, 18]}, {:gcd, [17, 5]}, {:gcd, [100, 100]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def inrange(x, lo, hi) := if x >= lo and x <= hi do 1 else 0 end\ndef outside(x, lo, hi) := if x < lo or x > hi do 1 else 0 end",
+      "def inrange(x Int53, lo Int53, hi Int53) Int53 := if x >= lo and x <= hi do 1 else 0 end\ndef outside(x Int53, lo Int53, hi Int53) Int53 := if x < lo or x > hi do 1 else 0 end",
+      [
+        {:inrange, [5, 1, 10]},
+        {:inrange, [15, 1, 10]},
+        {:outside, [5, 1, 10]},
+        {:outside, [15, 1, 10]}
+      ]
+    }
+  ]
+
+  describe "driver fixpoint — conditionals + comparisons run identically to Elixir" do
+    test "build/2 loads if/comparison/boolean functions equal to Rian.Beam's", %{drv: drv} do
+      for {rian_src, ref_src, calls} <- @corpus do
+        modname = :"cmp_cond_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+        loaded = drv.build(rian_src, modname)
+        assert loaded == modname
+
+        ref = ref_module(ref_src)
+
+        for {fname, args} <- calls do
+          assert apply(loaded, fname, args) == apply(ref, fname, args),
+                 "driver-loaded `#{fname}` diverged from Elixir toolchain on #{inspect(args)}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — `if` lowers to a case on the boolean; precedence is right" do
+    test "compile_module lowers `if` to a {:case, …} with true/false clauses", %{drv: drv} do
+      [_m, _exp, func] = drv.compile_module("def pick(a, b) := if a > b do a else b end", :pick)
+
+      assert {:function, 0, :pick, 2, [{:clause, 0, _params, [], [body]}]} = func
+
+      assert {:case, 0, {:op, 0, :>, {:var, 0, :A}, {:var, 0, :B}},
+              [
+                {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, true}], [], [{:var, 0, :A}]},
+                {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, false}], [], [{:var, 0, :B}]}
+              ]} = body
+    end
+
+    test "comparison binds looser than arithmetic (a + 1 > b parses as (a+1) > b)", %{drv: drv} do
+      m = drv.build("def f(a, b) := if a + 1 > b do 1 else 0 end", :cond_prec)
+      # a=3 -> a+1=4; 4 > 3 -> 1.  a=3,b=5 -> 4 > 5 -> 0.
+      assert apply(m, :f, [3, 3]) == 1
+      assert apply(m, :f, [3, 5]) == 0
+    end
+
+    test "Rian `<=` lowers to Erlang `=<` (and actually compiles)", %{drv: drv} do
+      [_m, _e, {:function, 0, :le, 2, [{:clause, 0, _, [], [{:op, 0, op, _, _}]}]}] =
+        drv.compile_module("def le(a, b) := a <= b", :le_check)
+
+      assert op == :"=<"
+    end
+  end
+end
